about_the_game:
※ This demo is a trial version of the game's prologue.

※ The current demo does not include voice acting. Whether voice acting will be added to the full version, as well as the languages supported, will depend on player feedback.

※ The demo contains content involving male suffering. Players are advised to proceed with caution.

※ The demo covers approximately 80% of the prologue. The full version is expected to have a single playthrough duration of 40 hours. Players who are not fond of long narrative AVGs should consider carefully.

※ The game is developed by a small team. If you encounter any bugs, please contact the development team via email.

A sci-fi otome AVG game where players will uncover the truth of the events by solving puzzles and making choices that trigger different endings.

In the year 2380, after humanity experienced the rebellion of the super AI Phoenix, civilization regressed by nearly a century. The use of mechanical intelligence was globally banned. Humanity turned its hopes for the future towards life sciences that could modify their own genes.

Two years later, without your knowledge, you were chosen by the AI Phoenix as a "Spark." During your involvement in a military operation in Kanteya City, you clashed with a red-haired interstellar pirate leader and a mysterious black-haired man. Your frequent activities exposed you to the undercurrents, and multiple factions, engaged in overt and covert struggles, reached out to you. Some wanted to extinguish you, others sought to claim you for themselves, and some even hailed you as the dawn of a new world.

With your mother's mysterious death, your father's demise in the stars, and your friends being innocently affected, who should you align with next, and where should you head?

Character Profiles

[Lorca]
Age: 20 | Height: 172cm | Weight: 52kg
Favorite Food: Chocolate
Full name: Lorca Plover. A genius AI engineer, rumored to have an IQ as high as his height. He suffers from hyperthymesia and asthma due to genetic defects. A hidden otaku, he enjoys arguing online but is reluctant to reveal his anime interests.
His physical fitness is extremely poor. Due to his health, he has never attended school, or his PE teacher would have been furious. He currently lives at the Hulie Island Leap Research Institute with the elderly physicist Hermes.
Do not mention Chihuahuas in front of him, or he might bite you.

[Zolayas]
Age: 22 | Height: 185cm | Weight: 70kg
Favorite Food: Tom Yum
Former leader of the Emberfire Pirates. Two years ago, the pirates were pacified by the Human Alliance, and Zolayas went alone to Earth for negotiations. After his ship entered Teliya Port, the crew was massacred, and Zolayas was captured. Later released by the AI Gaia, his hatred for the Human Alliance remains.
He now collaborates with Gennie, commander of the 5th Defense Force, serving under Gaia. Their默契 ended after an attack in Canteya City.

[Gennie]
Age: 24 | Height: 182cm | Weight: 69kg
Favorite Food: Anything you give him
A major in the military, promoted by Gaia to command the 5th Defense Force despite his low rank. Gennie grew up in war-torn times. After his father was conscripted, he signed a contract with the Havenberg Gene Research Institute to become an experimental subject to save his mother.
The experiments were grueling, but he found light in the darkness. In 2373, during transport to Kepler-186f, the research ship clashed with pirates, leading to its destruction. Gennie escaped his fate and befriended Zolayas, the pirate leader's son.

[Vladimir]
Age: Unknown | Height: 178cm | Weight: 225kg
Favorite Food: BBQ Pork Buns
A mysterious interstellar merchant living on Sicamo VI. Known for his terrifying grip and cunning nature. His true identity is ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇, and he has a father-son relationship with ▇▇▇. Due to clearance issues, more information cannot be disclosed.

[Zero]
Age: Unknown | Height: 175cm | Weight: 276kg
Favorite Food: Spicy Food
A mechanical intelligence purchased from Vladimir for 3 million credits on Sicamo VI. Skilled in protection, housekeeping, and assassination. Before meeting you, he harbored deep hatred for humans due to unpleasant memories. After a system reset, he loyally follows you, wearing the firefly necklace you gave him, starting a new life.

[Sully]
Age: 23 | Height: 185cm | Weight: 70kg
Favorite Food: Good kids don’t picky eat
The only son of the Gwen Group and future heir to the artificial colony Sicamo VI. Despite his wealth, he was raised to be law-abiding, optimistic, and upright.
His hobbies include watching hero shows and repairing ships, weapons, and battleships. Though he dresses like a mechanic and always smiles, his clothes and tools are all high-end, with even his wrench being a lifetime goal for most.
Sully embodies the phrase, "He’s richer than me and more driven."

content_descriptors.notes: Contains scenes of male characters with upper-body nudity during bathing, as well as violent content including war, conflict, fighting, and torture.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 或同等性能的AMD处理器
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 集成显卡（如Intel HD Graphics）即可
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10及其以上
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 或同等性能的AMD处理器
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 独立显卡
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: A sci-fi otome AVG game where players will take on the role of the "Spark" of a new world, encounter 6 male protagonists, and unlock different endings through puzzles and choices. Uncover the mystery behind your parents' death and discover the truth of the world.
